notes: *no more henceforth* holds three English words for `לֹא`, `תוֹסִף` and `עוֹד`: *no* to the negative, *more* as `יָסַף`'s own rendering and *henceforth* as `עוֹד`'s, which leaves no surplus on either side. The competing reading fuses `לֹא תוֹסִף` to *no more* and is named in the unit's note.

The object marker on the appositive `עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל` takes the appositional *even*, which is the family rule 16 allows because the marker stands on the very phrase the word introduces — unlike EZK.36.10, where no marker stands and the *even* is `added`.
